title: AWKUM MPhil Scholars Successfully Defend Their Theses in Botany
text:
Two MPhil Scholars Successfully Defend Their Theses at AWKUM

Department of Botany | Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

Two MPhil scholars from the
Department of Botany
,

Ms. Hira Khan
and

Ms. Sonehra Khan
,
successfully defended their MPhil theses today under the supervision of

Prof. Dr. Ikramullah Khan
, Professor of Botany at

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM)
and

Vice Chancellor, Hazara University, Mansehra
.

The thesis defense was conducted before a panel of distinguished experts,
with
Dr. Laal Badshah
, Assistant Professor,
Department of Botany, University of Peshawar,
serving as the
External Examiner
.
During the defense, both scholars presented their research findings with confidence
and effectively responded to the questions and observations raised by the examination committee.

Prof. Dr. Ikramullah Khan congratulated both scholars on the successful completion
and defense of their research work. He appreciated their dedication,
perseverance, and academic commitment throughout their MPhil studies.
He also acknowledged the valuable contribution of the external examiner in
maintaining the quality and academic standards of the evaluation process.

The successful defense of these MPhil theses reflects the

Department of Botany's
continued commitment to promoting
quality research, innovation, and academic excellence, thereby contributing
to the advancement of scientific knowledge and higher education at

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
.

Highlights

🎓 Two MPhil scholars successfully defended their theses.

👨‍🏫 Research supervised by Prof. Dr. Ikramullah Khan.

🔬 External evaluation conducted by Dr. Laal Badshah.

🌿 Department of Botany continues to promote quality research and academic excellence.
